formulas.K1: K1(t) = sigma0*sqrt(pi*L) for all t (SIF fixed by crack-face tractions); K1_0 = K1_inf = 1 [units sqrt(pi*L) per unit sigma0]
formulas.p_faces_0: p_faces(0+) = 2*(nu_u-nu)*sigma0/(alpha*(1-2*nu))  (Skempton value adjacent to the faces; faces carry sigma_xx=sigma_yy=-sigma0)
formulas.K2_0: K2(0+) = 0   (pore pressure on faces has no instantaneous mechanical effect)
formulas.K2_inf: K2(inf) = -(gamma/2)*p0*sqrt(pi*L)  (crack tends to close),  gamma = alpha*(1-2*nu)/(1-nu)
formulas.V2_inf: V2(inf) = -pi*(1-nu)*(gamma/2)*p0*L^2/G = -pi*alpha*(1-2*nu)*p0*L^2/(2*G) (negative = closure/interpenetration in the linear solution)
formulas.diffusivity_check: given c = 2*kappa*G*(1-nu)*(nu_u-nu)/(alpha^2*(1-2nu)^2*(1-nu_u)) reproduced by the 2D-trace (indices 1,2) reading of the constitutive laws
